name: TollTracker
description: iOS app for Bulgarian drivers that tracks your average speed in real time through toll-camera sections, runs in the background, and alerts you before you go over the section limit. Free download with in-app monthly/annual plans. Founded Sep 2025, BG.

mentions.evidence: ~$5,017 MRR, 1,293 active subscriptions, ~$6,344 L30, ~$14,873 last 3 months, ~$46,532 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~05:04 Warsaw (03:04 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Every country that rolls out section control or new toll rules gets one of these. In PL, the odcinkowy pomiar prędkości (section speed control) network keeps growing, and e-TOLL rules confuse foreign drivers. A "rules of the road for this country, live" app for cross-border drivers and fleets is a narrow but real subscription.

whyItPrints: A new government enforcement system (average-speed checks via toll cameras) creates instant fear of fines, and a $4 subscription is cheaper than one ticket. 1,293 subs at ~$3.88 average (my calculation) one year in, with zero B2B sales.
